description: Language-agnostic contract of the module meta of a captured module: whichever engine runs the captured files, import.meta.{url,path,filename,dir,dirname,main} of every module names that module, not its neighbour, and a module's text is otherwise untouched. A row is a file tree (path to text); `probe` names the module whose meta the entry prints; `expected` is the output with {root} for the absolute root of the tree.

files.entry.ts: import{meta as a}from"./a.ts";import{meta as b}from"./sub/b.ts";export async function runCapturedBuildSourceV1(){console.log(JSON.stringify({a,b}));}
